एबीएस? ये...

ओ तेरी!
अरे पर आप बीपी ना बढ़ाओ।

फुल कंट्रोल? अच्छा अच्छा। पीने के बाद भी?

Drunk. As described by an urban dictionary, refers to a state wherein you have to hold on to the grass to keep from falling off the earth.
Sounds hilarious, doesn't it?
It's equally fun to be drunk too.
Try it, will you?
Drink till you cannot feel your body from your nose to your toes.
Till everything feels like a whirlpool of color and laughter.

Go on, drink.
And after that one great session with your buddies, take a few more shots before picking up your car keys.
Yes, do so. Because why not? We're young and wild and free, right?
Get into that driver's seat and rev up the engine.
Pump up the music and add to the high.
Roll down those windows and just live.
Live.

And breathe that moment, that one moment of perfection and true meaning.
And while you're truly living.
Watch your car go out of control.
Let the bellowing screams of your passengers blow out all the noises from within you.
Fall into a pool of nothingness.
See a brief glimpse of your mother's face.
Just like those lines that fascinated you.
Realize.

In that one split second that you've given all you had.
For that one night, literally.
Remember how you will never see your girlfriend smile again.
How your brother is going to secretly lie awake under his blankets.
Waiting for you to return.
How your parents are going to hate having to lose the most precious sign of their love.
And your dreams of a big job and good education are all going to

To dream.
Just as you yourself are struggling to breathe.
Close your eyes.
Imagine.
And think twice before picking up those car keys.
Trust your better judgment.
For someone is waiting.
